WTO | Dispute settlement - Index of disputes issues WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION Home | About WTO | News & events | Trade topics | WTO membership | Documents & resources | External relations Contact us | Site map | A-Z | Search español français home trade topics dispute settlement the disputes disputes by subject DISPUTE SETTLEMENT: THE DISPUTES Index of disputes issues The list below indicates
        the issues that are
          the subjects of WTO disputes. Because there are often a number of ways
          to describe an issue, each dispute can appear under more than one
      heading. The issues are broadly classified under goods, intellectual   property and services. This summary has been prepared by the Secretariat under its own responsibility. The summary is for general information only and is not intended to affect the rights and obligations of Members. Click on a subject in this table to jump down the index.
